title: Cartwise Grocery Orders Customer Terms: Holding Several Orders
content:
## Customer terms — holding orders

These terms govern how many Cartwise Grocery Orders orders one customer may hold and how those orders stand toward one another.

**Clause 1.** A customer may hold any number of Cartwise Grocery Orders orders at the same time, including several open orders for different retailers or for different booked windows. No number of orders per customer is set as a maximum.

**Clause 2.** Each order is billed, refunded and tipped on its own.

**Clause 3.** The only limits that reach across a customer's orders are the rolling limits on item refunds and the on-time guarantee's rolling allowance of late-delivery refunds. No other rule of Cartwise Grocery Orders sets a limit that spans orders.

### The clauses restated

| Point | Position under these terms |
|---|---|
| Maximum number of open orders per customer | None |
| Open orders at different retailers or for different windows | Permitted side by side |
| Billing, refunds and tip | Settled order by order |
| Limits counted across all of a customer's orders | Only the rolling item-refund limits and the on-time guarantee's late-refund allowance |

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A customer holds three open Cartwise Grocery Orders orders: two at one retailer for different windows and one at another retailer. All three stand at once. Each carries its own fees, its own refunds and its own tip; a tip set on one of them is not a tip on the others. Only when an item refund or a late-delivery refund is weighed does the customer's history on the other orders enter, through the two cross-order limits named in Clause 3.
